mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and higher inflation expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy in a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer demand and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST YoY < -10%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO flat or declining
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO is flat or declining.
